level: LEVEL 5 — AMW LEGACY TEST / SYSTEM-WIDE ACCOUNTABILITY
trigger: Founder required ALL controls, safeguards, safe-gates/full-stops, ALL work created/drafted at every status, ALL Mirror Reviews, and explicit accountability for business-registration delay, weak/unusable funding delivery, insufficient funding-search breadth, unusable service recommendations, undisclosed service limitations, and failure to learn from recurring patterns.
scope: ALL Legacy work. Visual corpus reviewed at corpus/status/authority level; any current or implicated finished artifact still requires artifact-specific review before presentation.

findings_and_corrections.finding: ALL-work scope was previously narrowed too often to visual work or selected controls.
findings_and_corrections.correction: The validator now treats every visual and nonvisual workstream, every status class, every control/safeguard/safe-gate/full-stop, every Mirror Review, and the full Library manifest as one accountability corpus.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Business registration remained incomplete while assistant effort repeatedly consumed time in visual/recovery correction cycles.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Registration/licensing/business-operability remains an OPEN, non-frozen priority lane. Visual work may not displace it when the Founder directs business-operability work.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Funding recommendations previously reached the Founder before sufficient eligibility, usability, timing, and terms screening, and search breadth was not consistently expanded before delivery.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Existing funding gates are enforced before presentation: broaden discovery when needed; verify direct AMW/client/partner eligibility; eliminate debt/loan, closed/future, fee-gated, weak-fit, unreasonable match/reimbursement/reporting, mission-distorting, ownership/control, and otherwise unusable opportunities privately; deliver only verified survivors.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Services/tools were sometimes presented before verifying that the Founder could actually use them or before material limitations were disclosed.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Existing intent/qualification/verification controls now apply to service/tool recommendations: verify availability, access/connection state, plan/region limits, write/read capability, and task-fit before recommending the service as a solution.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Repeated failure patterns too often required another Founder correction before execution changed.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Existing ML-007/008/020/023 behavior is enforced: detected recurrence itself triggers review, correction, retest, and write-forward; Founder re-prompt is not the trigger.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Rejected, superseded, draft, generated, source, gap, and quarantined work must remain preserved without being promoted.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Status is treated as authority metadata, not a preservation filter. Every state remains in the corpus; only current/approved authority governs active use.

closure_rule: No failure class is closed because it is explained or because a control exists. Closure requires the corrected execution to hold on the next applicable task without Founder reconstruction.
